# <span id="aanchor463"></span> CALCit Calculator

CALCit offers a wide selection of calculators for use with FLOWCAL data.

The Gas Volume and Plate Size calculators are included with CALCit Integrated. For information on how to obtain additional calculators, contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="notelink">Customer Support</a>.

<div class="procedure">

To access CALCit:

- Go to the Settings Manager, and select **CALCit** in the **Calculators** group; or

- Go to the Volume Editor, right-click a meter, and select **Calculators**.

  Accessing CALCit from the Volume Editor will pre-populate the meter's characteristics in CALCit.
